name: TablePro
tagline: Browse schemas, edit data, and run SQL queries from a native database client.
description:
TablePro is an open-source database client with a native macOS interface. It brings connection management, schema browsing, SQL editing, and table data into one workspace.

## Features
- Connect to supported databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite.
- Write queries, browse schemas, and edit supported table data.
- Use Pro to compare supported databases, inspect local query history, and chart results.

## Privacy and requirements
The client connects to the databases you configure. Review connection settings, credentials, and database permissions before editing production data. Optional cloud and AI features have their own configuration.

## Pricing
The core app is free, including for work. The sale applies to the $79 Pro one-time license and the first year of the $39 Pro annual plan. Both cover up to three Macs.
pricingDetails: Free core app, Pro from $79 one-time or $39/year
